name: Billing
title: Blocks/Account/Billing
summary: The Billing page of the account settings: a `PageHeader` with the last update, Refresh and Documentation over `PageTabs` (Bills, Payment methods). Bills puts a Subscription plan `Card` (plan with a Current plan `Tag`, Change plan, and `KeyValueList` for plan start, next charge date and value as `CurrencyAmount`, and the default card with its `PaymentBrand`) beside an Upgrade to Enterprise `Card`, then Invoices on one `useCollection`: a controls row (`PropertyFilter`, Refresh, Download CSV, `CollectionPreferences`) over a `Table` with No., Invoice ID, Plan, Cycle, Seats, Billing date, Amount, Payment method, Status as `Table.CellStatus` and a download `IconButton` per invoice. Payment methods shows Payment information as `KeyValueList` (billing email, auto-renewal as `StatusIndicator`, address, tax ID) with Update, and a `Table` of cards (holder with a Default `Tag`, brand and last four, expiry, `Table.CellActions` with Set as default and Remove behind a `ConfirmDialog`). Outcomes go through `toast`. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the plan name and every value as skeletons, Change plan and Contact sales disabled, and the invoices table's loading rows.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The billing data did not load: a danger Alert with Retry replaces the tab's content; Retry loads it.

variants.name: NoInvoices
variants.summary: A new account before its first billing cycle closes: the plan cards, then a flush EmptyState that says when the first invoice appears.

variants.name: NoMatch
variants.summary: A Status = Overdue filter that matches no invoice: the table's empty slot says so and offers Clear filters.

variants.name: PaymentMethods
variants.summary: The Payment methods tab: Payment information with Update, then the cards with the default one tagged; Set as default and Remove (after confirmation) are wired.
